newsitem.title: USA: Brown Group sees Famous Footwear sales up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brown Group sees Famous Footwear sales up 10 pct.

text.p: Brown Group Inc said Thursday it expects its Famous Footwear shoe division's revenue will grow by 10 percent in 1997, with similar growth projected for the next three years.
In 1996, the Famous Footwear division's revenue rose eight percent to $781.3 million.

As the company's 20 new stores mature and more stores are slowly added, Famous Footwear's sales should grow by 10 to 15 percent annually, B.A. Bridgewater, chairman, told reporters after the annual meeting here Thursday.
Earlier today, Brown Group reported first quarter earnings of $1.5 million or $0.09 a share, up from last year's $527,000 or $0.03 a share.
At the end of the first quarter, Brown Group operated 803 Famous Footwear stores. It plans a net increase of 25 stores for Famous Footwear this year.
The company also plans to open about 25 new Naturalizer concept and outlet stores over the next year, bringing the total of Naturalizer stores to about 325.
